subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15744a82f5828a7824a05edb4aeb9134bc52a9810ef95dd05647ad228c64873e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Symbol [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd61340c19865d44f726929f9eb16efa342bc7948c97846f7029e8cbd062edfd.png] rotated 90 degree and shifted one place in anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8298901c8aaaca74919406fc6ecefb482e42b6fcc99e7b56310e09e3027678a.png] 

Step II: Symbol [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c25f18231aef96cd151470471b51bd2ccfaf6e6ee2353060132919785f557708.png] flipped 180 degree in alternate image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b13cf2258b26a5dc42fcd96291a6b657244345d240d78400fe26e0ce14d7f55.png] 

Step III: Symbol [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d25e07c3b225b4d1cb85e63747b4dd1bf048943d892039169b12bc081f990433.png] rotated 90 degree and shifted one place in anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d84490d8ea188423a07bc140fd68f0cee7f98bcfb8370c1322cddd9a94e08e8f.png] 

Step IV: Symbol [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18e201000c49fe31fd3d72cc92c8d052e72c1864341408a52f94a8665caaff67.png] rotated 90 degree and shifted one place in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db812cd9e0d830ce83f254593614c25b80674bdf1bda87b6ef0e806845cd5048.png] 

So, the complete series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6f4c6110a5e1736c2da6ac5b004620568c4a35789dc09a1b17c8b4f6836b58a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
